file_reasoning: CallCenter shared display converters with exact forward/reverse contracts.

resource_binding_reasoning.reasoning: Lowercases six known order states and preserves unknown source text; null/nonstring becomes empty. Localizes display only, never writes wire state.
Only boxed true becomes Visible; false/null/wrong type collapses. Useful positive guard, not permission enforcement.
Only true collapses; null/false/wrong type visible, so unset loading flag may reveal content. This is exact inverse of positive converter.
Null and empty string collapse, whitespace and all other objects visible. Whitespace errors can reserve empty-looking panel; no trim.
Null/empty visible for placeholder; whitespace nonempty collapses placeholder. Counterpart of null display converter.
True maps shared emerald brush, otherwise slate. Static brushes ignore theme changes; textual ShiftLabel must carry non-color meaning.

Required string parameter split two keys, true selects first; direct Application.Resources lookup. Invalid arity/key throws and concrete brush does not auto-reevaluate theme. CallCenter uses static light palette unlike cashier ThemeResources helper.
Ordinal value versus first parameter segment picks second/third app brush key. No parameter length/type validation; wrong case unselected. No UI mutation beyond returned brush.
Ordinal string equality yields visibility. Two nonstrings cast null and compare equal if parameter null; actual callers use explicit strings.
Requires non-generic ICollection Count>1; DTO variants exposing collection satisfy, arbitrary IEnumerable does not. Bound collection mutation will not itself reevaluate unless binding notified.
Accepts long/int using decimal money format; null em dash, wrong numeric type0.00 can hide schema mismatch. No arithmetic authority, display only.
Both forward and reverse return value is not true. Symmetric bool inversion for well-typed inputs; null/wrongtype becomes true. Reverse is implemented unlike other converters.
Null or ICollection Count0 visible; wrong type hidden. Changes require source notification; Count-based converter is safer for observable collection updates.
ICollection Count>0 visible, null/wrong type collapsed. Complement only for supported collection contract; not for arbitrary IEnumerable.

Extracts supplied calendar date from DateOnly/DateTime/DateTimeOffset or culture-parsed string; does not convert instant to Cairo despite name. Correct when caller supplies business-date carrier; arbitraryUTCnear-midnight can display wrong Cairo day.
DateTimeOffset converted machine local and ar-EG time; DateTime used as supplied. Not pinned Cairo, so remote station displays its clock zone. Unsupported em dash.
Known module-key dictionary to Fluent private-use glyph; unknown/nonstring generic fallback. Textual navigation label needed for accessibility, no new screen construction.

Lowercase substring bucket tests success before failure/warning. Future unpaid/inactive could match paid/active; current emitted vocabulary not verified for those strings, candidate only. Direct app resources, neutral fallback.

Absolute Uri key cached in static locked dictionary, BitmapImage decodewidth320. Relative URI AbsoluteUri throws; no eviction/download-failure retry invalidation. Version URLs accumulate process lifetime. No physical printing or database call.
Only int0 visible; Count-property binding receives changes unlike collection object. Negative/wrongtype collapses; actual Count cannot negative.
Only positive int visible. Zero/null/wrongtype collapsed, matching saved-address count UI. No side effects or enumeration.

tests_and_limits: SOURCE_REVIEW_ONLY. All43 callable stable spans individually reconciled, including21 forward/reverse pairs and Format. No native runtime tests; no blanket migration from legacy headings.
recommendations: Test required parameter arity, display types, absolute image URLs, bounded cache and timestamp semantics; keep unknown state neutral.
